architectures.name: Micro-Reservoir Architecture
architectures.mechanism: Therapeutic agent retention via micro-reservoirs within the eShunt
architectures.structure: Micro-reservoirs integrated into the eShunt's one-way valve, with a porous membrane for agent release
architectures.materials: Polymer-based micro-reservoirs, porous membrane (e.g., PEEK, PTFE)
architectures.therapeutic_behavior: Retains therapeutic agent within micro-reservoirs, releasing via porous membrane
architectures.control_logic: Therapeutic agent release controlled by flow rate and pressure
architectures.manufacturing_implication: Micro-reservoirs require precise manufacturing and integration
architectures.regulatory_implication: Class II or III medical device, depending on micro-reservoir material
architectures.eshunt_specific_relationship: Integrates with eShunt's one-way valve and porous membrane

architectures.name: Therapeutic Coating Architecture
architectures.mechanism: Therapeutic agent retention via eShunt coating
architectures.structure: Therapeutic agent-loaded coating applied to the eShunt's inner surface
architectures.materials: Therapeutic agent-loaded polymer coating (e.g., PEG, PLGA)
architectures.therapeutic_behavior: Therapeutic agent released from coating as CSF flows through
architectures.control_logic: Therapeutic agent release controlled by flow rate and pressure
architectures.regulatory_implication: Class II or III medical device, depending on coating material
architectures.eshunt_specific_relationship: Coating applied to eShunt's inner surface
